# nycroutes ![](reference/figures/nycroutes.png)

Spatial and tabular data describing the New York City subway system,
derived from the MTA’s GTFS feed. Includes route shapes, stops, parent
stations, directional platforms, transfers, and pre-computed offset
versions of routes and stops suitable for schematic mapping.

## Installation

You can install the development version of nycroutes from
[GitHub](https://github.com/) with:

``` r
# install.packages("remotes")
remotes::install_github("kjhealy/nycroutes")
```

## Load

``` r
library(nycroutes)
library(dplyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(sf)
```

## Example

A quick map of the subway system, coloring each route by its MTA brand
color and marking parent stations:

``` r
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(
    data = nyc_subway_routes_sf,
    mapping = aes(color = route_color),
    linewidth = 0.4,
    alpha = 0.8
  ) +
  geom_sf(
    data = nyc_subway_stops_parent_sf,
    size = 0.3,
    color = "grey20"
  ) +
  scale_color_identity() +
  labs(
    title = "NYC subway routes and stations",
    caption = "Source: MTA GTFS feed"
  ) +
  theme_void()
#> Warning: Removed 110 rows containing missing values or values outside the scale range
#> (`geom_sf()`).
```

![](reference/figures/README-subway-map-1.png)

# Package index

## Subway routes

Route metadata and route shape geometries.

- [`nyc_subway_routes_df`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_routes_df.md)
  : NYC subway routes
- [`nyc_subway_routes_sf`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_routes_sf.md)
  : NYC subway route shapes

## Subway stops

Station and platform point locations.

- [`nyc_subway_stops_sf`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_stops_sf.md)
  : NYC subway stops
- [`nyc_subway_stops_parent_sf`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_stops_parent_sf.md)
  : NYC subway parent stations
- [`nyc_subway_stops_platform_sf`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_stops_platform_sf.md)
  : NYC subway directional platforms

## Transfers

Transfer relationships between stops.

- [`nyc_subway_transfers_df`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_transfers_df.md)
  : NYC subway transfers

## Station complexes

Bridge tables between MTA `station_complex_id` (used by the ridership
packages) and GTFS parent `stop_id` and `route_id`.

- [`nyc_subway_complexes_df`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_complexes_df.md)
  : NYC subway station complexes
- [`nyc_subway_complexes_sf`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_complexes_sf.md)
  : NYC subway station complexes (sf)
- [`nyc_subway_complex_stops_df`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_complex_stops_df.md)
  : NYC subway complex-to-parent-stop mapping
- [`nyc_subway_complex_routes_df`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_complex_routes_df.md)
  : NYC subway complex-to-route service map
- [`nyc_subway_stop_routes_df`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_stop_routes_df.md)
  : NYC subway parent-stop route service map

## Schematic (offset) layers

Pre-computed offset routes and stops for schematic maps.

- [`nyc_subway_routes_offset_sf`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_routes_offset_sf.md)
  : NYC subway route shapes with schematic offsets
- [`nyc_subway_stops_offset_sf`](https://kjhealy.github.io/nycroutes/reference/nyc_subway_stops_offset_sf.md)
  : NYC subway stops with schematic offsets
